title: Search History Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template to request deletion of your search history data from companies. Protect your privacy with this formal letter template.
description: A formal letter template to request companies delete your stored search history data. Includes legal references and professional language to ensure your privacy requests are taken seriously and processed quickly.

sections.heading: Subject Line
sections.content: Subject: Formal Request for Deletion of Search History Data Under Privacy Rights

sections.heading: Opening Statement
sections.content:
Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to formally request the complete deletion of all search history data associated with my account. This request is made under my privacy rights as outlined in applicable data protection regulations, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and similar state privacy laws.

sections.heading: Account Information
sections.content:
Please find my account details below for identification purposes:

• Account Email: [your_email]
• Account Username: [username]
• Associated Phone Number: [phone_number]
• Approximate Account Creation Date: [creation_date]

I can provide additional verification information if required to process this request.

sections.heading: Specific Deletion Request
sections.content:
I specifically request the deletion of the following data:

• All search queries and search history
• Search-related activity logs and timestamps
• Location data associated with searches
• Any derived data or profiles based on my search activity
• Search history backups and archived data
• Any data shared with third-party partners related to my searches

Please ensure this deletion is permanent and irreversible across all your systems and databases.

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Timeline
sections.content:
This request is made under my right to erasure and data portability as protected by:
• California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)
• State privacy regulations
• Your company's published privacy policy

I understand you have [timeline_days] days to respond to this request. Please confirm receipt of this request and provide a timeline for completion. I also request written confirmation once the deletion is complete.

sections.heading: Contact Information and Closing
sections.content:
Please send all correspondence regarding this request to:
Email: [your_email]
Phone: [your_phone]

If you need additional information or verification to process this request, please contact me promptly. I appreciate your attention to this matter and look forward to your confirmation.

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]

useCases: Requesting Google to delete years of accumulated search history
Asking search engines to remove sensitive or embarrassing queries
Protecting privacy before sharing devices with family members
Exercising legal rights under CCPA and state privacy laws
Preventing search history from influencing targeted advertising
Securing privacy after a data breach or security concern
